## 2. Key Retry Mechanism Pattern

The core retry logic follows this pattern:

```rust
// Error detection
Err(e) if e.raw_os_error() == Some(ETXTBSY_ERRNO) && attempt + 1 < max_attempts => {
    last_err = Some(e);
    warn!(
        "ETXTBSY error detected (attempt {}/{}), retrying in {}ms",
        attempt + 1, max_attempts, backoff_ms
    );
    // Backoff sleep
    thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(backoff_ms));
}
```
